prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE genuinely new full-body production game miniature, 2:3 portrait RGBA transparent, not a recolor or cutout of references. New pose left arm lowered open hand, right palm forward by hip, no combat. Do not copy SEDDQ coat or heavy 1180Y armor.
